items.questionText: Conduct
items.correctAnswer: a) to carry out a particular activity or process, especially in order to get information or prove facts  b) to stand in front of a group of musicians or singers and direct their playing or singing

items.questionText: Aim (v)
items.correctAnswer: to try or intend to achieve something

items.questionText: Artefact
items.correctAnswer: an object that was made in the distant past and is historically important

items.questionText: Primitive
items.correctAnswer: a) belonging to a simple way of life that existed in the past and does not have modern industries and machines  b) (not modern) something that is very simple and does not have the extra modern parts that would make it faster, better, more comfortable, etc.

items.questionText: Pause
items.correctAnswer: to stop doing something for a short time before starting again

items.questionText: Impose
items.correctAnswer: a) to force someone to accept something like a rule, belief, or system  b) to take advantage of someone by demanding their support or attention

items.questionText: Justify
items.correctAnswer: to give an acceptable explanation for something that other people think is unreasonable

items.questionText: Deny
items.correctAnswer: to say that something is not true, or that you do not believe something

items.questionText: Generate
Opponent
items.correctAnswer: a) someone who you try to defeat in a competition, game, fight, or argument  b) someone who disagrees with a plan, idea, or system and wants to try to stop or change it
